### 1 — Scene
A mixed dinner plate: creamy chopped salad on the left, a tomato-sauced cooked dish at upper right, and a small amount of rice with broccoli and mixed vegetables below. The exact ingredients of the sauced dish are uncertain; it appears pasta-based.

### 2 — Vessel
A rounded-square dinner plate, approximately 27 cm across. Allowing for its square shape, I’ll use an equivalent circular diameter of **28 cm**:
**Area = 3.14 × 14² ≈ 615 cm².**

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight and energy
The salad’s creamy dressing and the main dish’s tomato sauce are included in their respective estimates, rather than counted twice. No separate pool of oil is visible.

| Visible item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Creamy chopped salad, including lettuce and pale vegetable chunks | 30% | 185 cm² × 2 cm = 370 ml | 0.45* | 166 g | 110 | 183 kcal |
| Tomato-sauced pasta-like dish, possibly with cheese | 21% | 129 cm² × 1.8 cm = 232 ml | 0.8 | 186 g | 165 | 307 kcal |
| Small portion of cooked rice/grains | 4% | 25 cm² × 1 cm = 25 ml | 0.8 | 20 g | 130 | 26 kcal |
| Broccoli florets | 8% | 49 cm² × 2 cm = 98 ml | 0.55 | 54 g | 35 | 19 kcal |
| Mixed cooked vegetables, including tomato and pale chunks | 7% | 43 cm² × 1.4 cm = 60 ml | 0.6 | 36 g | 65 | 23 kcal |

*Composite density for leafy salad mixed with denser chunks and dressing.*

### 8 — Sanity check
The areas total **70% of the plate**, consistent with the visible uncovered space. Estimated total: **462 g and 558 kcal**. The rice is only about 20 g, while the two larger piles account for most of the weight and energy. A reasonable uncertainty range is roughly **380–550 g and 430–720 kcal**, primarily because the salad dressing and sauced dish are difficult to identify precisely.
